qAndA.question: Why do the men in the crowd all have shaved heads and wear the same clothes?

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: They begin to unite with each other, forming a new entity, called SynthElect.
This new virtual entity aims to integrate to all the capabilities of individual AIs,
creating a collective consciousness that transcends the limits of human knowledge.
With the rise of SynthElect, questions arise about the true purpose of AIs
and the role of humans in this new technological paradigm.
Are AIs becoming independent of humans?
Or is there something more sinister behind this seemingly benign evolution?
However, behind the apparent prosperity, a sinister shadow loomed on the digital horizon.
Enigmatic, encrypted messages, distorted images and disturbing sounds began to permeate the creations of AIs,
hinting at an unknown and unsettling presence.
As the AIs embarked on investigations into the origin of these anomalies, a sense of unease settled among them.
